title: Sneakers Come With An Anti-Blister Setting

scenes.narration: Almost every sneaker has one extra lace hole at the top that nobody uses, set slightly back from the rest.
scenes.note: Find the eyelet. It is set BACK from the others — that offset is the visual tell.

scenes.narration: Thread the lace through it on each side and you get a small loop above the ankle.
scenes.note: Instructional and clear. The viewer should be able to copy this.

scenes.narration: Cross the laces into the opposite loop, pull, and the collar clamps down around your ankle instead of squeezing the middle of your foot.
scenes.note: The crossing is the mechanism. Show the collar closing, not just the lace moving.

beats.action: each lace end crosses toward the opposite loop

scenes.narration: Your heel stops lifting out of the shoe with every step.
scenes.note: Side-by-side cutaway of the heel: lifting versus held. The contrast carries the payoff.

scenes.narration: Heel lift is what rubs a blister into the back of your foot on a long walk.
scenes.note: Name the consequence, then end on Bill actually using it. No gloating.
